artifact_delivered: Fixed calibration integration bug in sensor_history.py. Added --raw flag. Verified: calibrated values (50.2%) stored alongside raw (95.8%).
workstream_summary: Found and fixed critical bug: collect_one() loaded calibration but didn't pass it to apply_calibration(). After fix, sensor history stores both raw and calibrated values. Tested against live ESP32 — calibration offset correctly applied, anomalies dropped to 0.
